paper_statement: 7-13 um QCL with approximately 9-16 um diffraction-limited spot size; radius/diameter convention not stated
paper_SI_gaussian_definition: I=2P/(pi*w0^2)*exp(-2*r^2/w0^2); w0 is the 1/e^2 intensity radius
scenario_interpretation: diameter interpretation of the reported 9-16 um spot-size range; explicit scenarios, not a confidence interval or paper-certified beam

current_comparison.normalization: same integrated incident power for every waist and polarization; raw unit-intensity optical powers reported separately
current_comparison.thermal_operator: unchanged 60 um lateral, 20 um Si depth, 100 nm core xy, 10 nm TaIrTe4 z explicit 3D FVM
current_comparison.terminal_current: full flake-cell volume integral with cell volume applied exactly once

follow_up_rule: Only after the three s0 waist pairs are reported may one selected waist receive s0 plus/minus 1 um position solves; no automatic dense scan
